description_en: Sends a remote assistance request from an administrator to an end user. This operation is mainly used in administrator assistance scenarios and education scenarios
description_zh: 管理员向终端用户发起远程协助请求。主要用于管理员协助场景和教育场景
kebab_example: aliyun ecd apply-coordination-for-monitoring --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --uuid 3E14A18BD4D088504B9F8A8751AB0000 --initiator-type ADMIN_INITIATE --coordinate-policy-type FULL_CONTROL --resource-candidates OwnerEndUserId=alice ResourceRegionId=cn-hangzhou ResourceId=ecd-08zhejm3h7ilr0000 ResourceName=DemoComputer ResourceType=CLOUD_DESKTOP ResourceProperties=TestProperty OwnerAliUid=1302470215170000 --end-user-id alice --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ApplyCoordinationForMonitoring

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The UUID (unique identifier) of the device
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en: The access policy during the remote assistance procedure
parameters.help_zh: 远程协助过程中的权限策略
parameters.name: coordinate_policy_type

element_fields.help_en: The region where the resource resides
element_fields.name: resource_region_id

element_fields.help_en: The properties of the cloud computer
element_fields.name: resource_properties

element_fields.help_en:
The username of the current user of the cloud computer.

> This field is required
element_fields.help_zh:
云电脑当前使用者的用户名。

> 该字段为必填项
element_fields.name: owner_end_user_id

element_fields.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the cloud computer administrator
element_fields.help_zh: 云电脑管理员的阿里云账号ID
element_fields.name: owner_ali_uid

parameters.help_en: The list of cloud computers that need to accept remote assistance
parameters.help_zh: 需接受远程协助的云电脑列表
parameters.name: resource_candidates

parameters.help_en: The ID of the end user who initiates the coordination flow. This parameter is not required if the request is initiated by an administrator
parameters.help_zh: 发起流协同的终端用户ID。若管理员发起，则不需要填写
parameters.name: end_user_id
